regressionComparisons.qualification: Compares commands, complete public packet hashes, source prefix kinds, acquisition counters and reported series projections. Observation session scope is normalized. Session-derived hashed program model IDs are excluded while their acquisition epochs, normalized evidence and observed/inferred operator counts remain compared. Native graph chains/revisions and shared inherited digests are excluded. Prior acquired-preparation deferrals and guards are compared. New quota/relation projections must remain empty on these prior successful prefixes; prior radial/control-discovery and other series evidence remain compared. No partial-access extension is required in these prefixes. Timings are excluded; this is not a speed comparison or full internal-state parity.
